row.diff:
diff --git a/labels.py b/labels.py
index 75ebae6..e07d4a1 100644
--- a/labels.py
+++ b/labels.py
@@ -9,8 +9,14 @@ def read_boxes(path):
 
 
 def label(box):
-    """Text for one label, one item per line."""
-    lines = [f"BOX {box['box']}", box["owner"]]
+    """Text for one label, one item per line.
+
+    Line order: BOX n, owner, ROOM x.xx, then FRAGILE (if fragile) last.
+    """
+    room = (box.get("room") or "").strip()
+    if not room:
+        raise ValueError(f"box {box['box']} has no room")
+    lines = [f"BOX {box['box']}", box["owner"], f"ROOM {room}"]
     if box.get("fragile", "").lower() == "yes":
         lines.append("FRAGILE")
     return "\n".join(lines)
diff --git a/tests/test_labels.py b/tests/test_labels.py
index 3143e53..3bea368 100644
--- a/tests/test_labels.py
+++ b/tests/test_labels.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import pytest
+
 import labels
 
 
@@ -15,3 +17,27 @@ def test_read_boxes(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "boxes.csv"
     p.write_text("box,owner,room,fragile\n1,Ana,3.01,no\n", encoding="utf-8")
     assert labels.read_boxes(p)[0]["room"] == "3.01"
+
+
+def test_room_line_follows_owner():
+    box = {"box": "3", "owner": "Ana", "room": "2.14", "fragile": "no"}
+    assert labels.label(box).splitlines() == ["BOX 3", "Ana", "ROOM 2.14"]
+
+
+def test_fragile_is_last_after_room():
+    box = {"box": "4", "owner": "Ana", "room": "2.14", "fragile": "yes"}
+    assert labels.label(box).splitlines() == [
+        "BOX 4", "Ana", "ROOM 2.14", "FRAGILE"
+    ]
+
+
+def test_room_whitespace_is_stripped():
+    box = {"box": "5", "owner": "Ana", "room": " 2.14 ", "fragile": "no"}
+    assert labels.label(box).splitlines()[2] == "ROOM 2.14"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("room", ["", "   ", None])
+def test_blank_room_is_an_error(room):
+    box = {"box": "6", "owner": "Ana", "room": room, "fragile": "no"}
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        labels.label(box)
